# NFLVERSE schema (generated by scripts/build_schema_doc.py)
Query tables as NFLVERSE.<table>.
- Player IDs (GSIS, e.g. 00-0031408): player_stats.player_id = pbp.passer_player_id /
  receiver_player_id / rusher_player_id = rosters.gsis_id = injuries.gsis_id = depth_charts.gsis_id.
- snap_counts has no GSIS ID: join snap_counts.pfr_player_id = rosters.pfr_id, or match
  snap_counts.player = player_stats.player_display_name.
- game_id (e.g. 2026_01_SF_LA = season_week_away_home) links player_stats, pbp, snap_counts,
  schedules. season, week and team codes (SF, GB, ...) are shared by all tables.
- Full names: player_stats.player_display_name, snap_counts.player, rosters/injuries.full_name,
  depth_charts.player_name. Abbreviated ("M.Evans"): player_stats.player_name, pbp *_player_name.
- Shares (target_share, air_yards_share, offense_pct) are fractions 0-1.
- pbp flags (pass, rush, touchdown, interception, ...) are 0.0/1.0: SUM() them to count.
- season_type / game_type: REG or POST.

## NFLVERSE.player_stats (one row per player per game)
Columns: player_id, player_name, player_display_name, position, season, week, season_type, game_id, team, opponent_team, completions, attempts, passing_yards, passing_tds, passing_interceptions, passing_air_yards, passing_2pt_conversions, carries, rushing_yards, rushing_tds, rushing_2pt_conversions, receptions, targets, receiving_yards, receiving_tds, receiving_air_yards, receiving_yards_after_catch, receiving_2pt_conversions, target_share, air_yards_share, wopr, fumbles_lost_total, fantasy_points, fantasy_points_ppr
Notes: receiving_air_yards: air yards on all targets; target_share: share of team targets in the game; air_yards_share: share of team air yards in the game; wopr: 1.5 * target_share + 0.7 * air_yards_share; fantasy_points: standard (non-PPR); fantasy_points_ppr: PPR

## NFLVERSE.pbp (one row per play)
Columns: game_id, play_id, season, week, season_type, posteam, defteam, game_half, qtr, down, ydstogo, yardline_100, play_type, pass, rush, pass_attempt, rush_attempt, complete_pass, passer_player_id, passer_player_name, receiver_player_id, receiver_player_name, rusher_player_id, rusher_player_name, air_yards, yards_after_catch, yards_gained, touchdown, pass_touchdown, rush_touchdown, two_point_attempt, interception, fumble_lost, epa
Notes: posteam: offense; defteam: defense; game_half: Half1, Half2, Overtime; yardline_100: yards from the opponent's end zone; <= 20 is the red zone; play_type: pass, run, punt, field_goal, kickoff, extra_point, qb_kneel, qb_spike, no_play; pass: dropback, incl. sacks and scrambles; rush: designed run; receiver_player_id: targeted receiver; epa: expected points added

## NFLVERSE.snap_counts (one row per player per game)
Columns: game_id, season, game_type, week, player, pfr_player_id, position, team, opponent, offense_snaps, offense_pct
Notes: offense_pct: share of team offensive snaps

## NFLVERSE.depth_charts (snapshots, many per week; current chart = rows with the team's MAX(dt))
Columns: dt, week, team, player_name, gsis_id, pos_grp, pos_abb, pos_slot, pos_rank
Notes: dt: snapshot timestamp (UTC); week: week of the team's next game on or after dt; pos_grp: formation, e.g. '3WR 1TE', 'Base 4-3 D', 'Special Teams'; pos_abb: QB, RB, WR, TE, ...; pos_slot: formation slot; backups share their starter's slot; pos_rank: depth order within the team's position (1 = top)

## NFLVERSE.injuries (weekly injury report, one row per player per week)
Columns: season, game_type, week, game_date, team, gsis_id, full_name, position, report_primary_injury, report_secondary_injury, report_status, practice_primary_injury, practice_status
Notes: game_date: date of the team's game that week; report_status: Out, Doubtful, Questionable, or null; practice_status: Full / Limited / Did Not Participate In Practice

## NFLVERSE.rosters (weekly roster, one row per player per week)
Columns: season, week, team, gsis_id, pfr_id, full_name, position, depth_chart_position, jersey_number, status, status_description_abbr, years_exp, rookie_year, entry_year
Notes: status: ACT active, RES reserve/IR, INA inactive, DEV practice squad, CUT, TRD, RET

## NFLVERSE.schedules (one row per game; scores are null for games not played yet)
Columns: game_id, season, game_type, week, gameday, weekday, gametime, away_team, home_team, away_score, home_score, result, total, overtime, away_rest, home_rest, div_game, roof, surface, away_qb_id, away_qb_name, home_qb_id, home_qb_name
Notes: gameday: date; gametime: US Eastern, HH:MM; result: home_score - away_score; total: home_score + away_score; away_rest: days of rest; home_rest: days of rest; home_qb_name: starting QBs
